facts.fact: Lantana grows in thick banks down the slope of the east path to the fort kalari; Gopan keeps meaning to cut it. The pit is about twenty paces across and shoulder-deep, shored with laterite blocks, with lamps in niches round the rim and steps cut in the north side.
facts.why: needed because the beat sends Neela through lantana to the kalari and the pit needs physical layout for the scene.

facts.fact: Neela tells Devan she learned to read feet from 'a man who guarded pepper', one of two guards at Kunjan Chirayil's warehouse (cover story). Devan accepts it.
facts.why: needed because Neela must justify her skill to correct his stance without breaking her cover.

facts.fact: Muthu asks Devan for a round every seventh day and Devan refuses every time; Devan states he has not sparred for 'eight years in the spring'.
facts.why: echoes F060 and F032 and gives a concrete reason for Devan's refusal to spar.
